execution_policy.inputs: Only the six paraphrased public-request summaries, requirement annotations, exclusions, and scoping template.
execution_policy.quality: Automatic contract checks are necessary but not sufficient. Free-text drafts require human review before quality-preserving optimization can be promoted.
execution_policy.retries: None. Stop after transport, telemetry, output-cap, or identity failure; preserve uncertain reservations.
execution_policy.tools: None. No source fetch, private data, client contact, deployment, or full-project execution.

pricing_source.boundary: Standard Global synchronous requests, short context. Retail-rate calculated cost, not reconciled invoice, discounts, tax, or procurement budget. Batching here means merging work into one normal request, not the Azure Batch API.

feature_definitions.prompt_bytes: Declared quote-time prompt byte count; no measured usage.
feature_definitions.context_bytes: Validated quote metadata; not an additional model feature.
feature_definitions.planned_output_tokens: Declared quote-time output allowance, not actual output.
feature_definitions.total_scoping_units: Sum of extract, classify, plan, and report counts.
feature_definitions.planned_calls: Number of declared requests, not realized tool or retry counts.
feature_definitions.max_operations_per_call: Largest declared batch of independent scoping operations.

support.interpretation: Within marginal ranges does not establish joint or domain support.

cost_definition: Direct regression of recorded retail-rate API cost, not invoice cost.
limitations: Tokens and cost are separately selected regressions; cost is not repriced token predictions.
All observed failures of automatic quality checks retain their incurred cost.
No tools, clarification loops, retries, new model versions, or full delivery were measured.
Only extract, classify, plan, report were executed; broader proposed bricks are untrained.
No per-brick causal cost or independent coefficient identification is established.
